GOAL: orient before ideation; confirm progress tool + repo layout.
READ: session brief (single idea, scope contract, frozen budget 24556 items/24 steps/3000 epochs), prior round list.
OBSERVED: append_progress available via tools.progress.append_progress; no shell, no write.
NEXT: inspect workspace/repo for existing SID+hyperbolic mechanisms so the idea is not a copy.

FINAL ANSWER (summary of the deliverable; full text is printed in the reply).
GOAL: produce exactly one in-scope idea coupling training-only behaviour with hyperbolic geometry inside RQ-VAE SID construction, distinct from prior rounds (fork-angle-transport, branch-geodesic-rank, GEO-SHELL-RQ, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, GEOPFX-SID, SUCC-TAN-RQ, GYRO-TARGET-RQ).
IDEA: BEH-SINKHORN-CURVED-MARGINAL.
MECHANISM: RQ-VAE code selection at each level becomes the argmax of a Sinkhorn optimal-transport plan over the batch of latents, whose ground cost is the fixed-curvature (c=1) Poincare ball distance between radius-squashed latents and codebook points, and whose column marginal is a frozen behaviour mass b_k proportional to n_k + alpha*g_k, where g_k is the popularity-adjusted successor-branching mass of TRAIN items served by code k, alpha = mean(g)/(mean(g)+mean(n)) derived at init, eps = median(C) derived at init. Row marginal uniform, 30 log-domain iterations, straight-through gradient.
WHY DISTINCT: behaviour enters as a CONSTRAINT of the same transport whose cost is geometric, not as an extra loss, rank objective, shell penalty, cone constraint or tangent transport; no added loss term.
SWITCHES (exist, not trained): BEHAV_SINKHORN=False (uniform marginal), GEOM_POINCARE=False (squared Euclidean cost), both on = the single trained run.
COST: ~25M extra flops, 2-4 ms/step, +2-4% wall clock; 3 Sinkhorn solves of 1024x256 per step over 72000 steps (24x3000).
LEAKAGE: g from TRAIN only, frozen pre-Stage2; n_k from TRAIN assignments per epoch; val only logged; test untouched until Stage-3.
SAFEGUARDS: radius clamp 1-1e-5, arcosh arg >= 1+1e-7, marginal floor 1e-6/K, log-domain, 30-iter cap, nearest-neighbour fallback on ties/NaN.
OBSERVABLES: per-level usage entropy, high-branching share in top codes, Stage-2 first-token prefix accuracy, ER/collisions, Stage-3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065.
STATUS: complete; nothing open except the single training run.
